scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false), not the author's working copy. Collection of QGIS plugins and Processing scripts, not a web service. Shell/batch files (Makefiles, .sh, .bat) skimmed only; full interface/data-access detection for shell is out of scope for skill version 1.0. Images, QGIS styles/projects (.qml, .qgz, .qmd), Qt resource/UI files and docs excluded. Scripts/metadatamanager is a near-duplicate of Plugins/metadata_manager. Plugins/metadata_manager/db/manager.py and widgets were not read line-by-line. Extra key secrets_and_credentials.cli_credential_exposure was added for the --password option.

file_system_access.detail: writes exported web map (style.json, index.html, serve.py, README) to user output folder; deletes temp gpkg
copies and renames vector files with backups
writes .qmd metadata files next to datasets
scans directory trees, records scanning username (getpass.getuser), runs `df`

what_this_app_can_do: Inventories vector/raster files in directory trees into a GeoPackage and records the scanning OS username and file paths.
Edits and writes QGIS .qmd metadata (including contact email/phone) for datasets via a wizard.
Exports a QGIS project as a PMTiles web map and writes a serve.py that serves the folder over HTTP on all interfaces with permissive CORS and no login.
Reads and edits QGIS project XML stored in a PostgreSQL table using credentials typed into a GUI.
Renames vector layers/tables in bulk, with file backups.
Uploads a plugin zip to plugins.qgis.org using the author's credentials.

data_sources_touched.source: unpkg.com / protomaps hosts (loaded by exported web map in the viewer's browser)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Desktop tools run locally by the user. The one network listener is the optional serve.py generated for exported web maps: it binds all interfaces with no authentication, so anyone on the local network can read the exported map folder while it is running.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: Generated serve.py binds 0.0.0.0 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin * and no authentication
plugin_upload.py accepts the password via -w/--password command-line option (visible in shell history/process list) though it prompts if omitted
Inventory records the OS username of the scanner and file paths into a database
